Window controlled Dark mode

Motion·by @mjbarton_·2026-08-29·inspora page·original post

What it is

Window-controlled dark mode: a portfolio page topped by a realistic airplane window; dragging the window's shade down physically dims the whole page into dark mode, shade up restores light - a skeuomorphic theme switch.

Media

Frame-by-frame

0-20%
Light portfolio page: airplane window (bright sky visible) above the bio text; shade fully up.
20-40%
Shade dragged partially down: the sky in the window occludes top-down; page brightness begins to fall in sync.
40-60%
Shade ~70%: page visibly dimming (grey veil), window shows a sliver of sky left at bottom.
60-80%
Shade fully down: page in near-black dark mode; window is a dark rounded panel with faint interior reflections; text flips to light-on-dark.
80-100%
Shade pulled back up: page brightens back to light mode; sky returns in the window.

Build prompt

Rebuild this interaction 1:1: window-controlled dark mode - a portfolio page topped by a realistic airplane window; dragging the window's shade down physically dims the whole page into dark mode, shade back up restores light. A skeuomorphic theme switch.

## Integration
Integration: stack-agnostic spec - springs given as stiffness/damping, timed motions as duration + curve, canvas/shader notes are perf guidance only; map every value to your framework and animation library of choice.

## Scene
Light portfolio page (bio text below). Top: an airplane window component - rounded frame, bright sky photo inside, a shade panel clipped to the window's inner shape. Shade handle grabbable at its bottom edge.

## Motion spec
Pattern: gesture-driven scrub with lerped theme.
- Drag: shade translateY 1:1 with the finger, clipped to the window frame; sky occludes top-down as the shade covers it.
- Page theme: background, text, and surface colors lerp from light to dark in sync with shade position (0 = light, 1 = full dark) - a continuous dim, not a binary flip. Around 70% shade the page is visibly veiling; at 100% it is near-black with light-on-dark text; the window shows only a dark panel with faint interior reflections.
- Tap toggle: animates the shade to the opposite end over 600ms, ease-in-out.
- Drag up reverses everything continuously.

## Calibration
- The lerp must be perceptually uniform - dim the page through intermediate greys, don't jump at 50%.
- Shade motion is strictly 1:1 while dragging; any easing on the scrub breaks the physical link.
- Toggle fallback 600ms ease-in-out for keyboard/click users.

## Reduced motion
Shade still moves 1:1 (positional); the theme lerp shortens to a 150ms crossfade between light and dark endpoints.

## Don't miss
- Theme values come from shade position continuously - mid-drag means mid-theme.
- The shade is clipped to the window's rounded shape; it must never poke out of the frame.
- At full dark, the window itself goes dark with faint reflections - it participates in the theme.

Mechanics

trigger
vertical drag on the window shade (or tap to toggle)
elements
airplane window (frame, sky photo, shade panel), page theme
properties
shade translateY (clipped), page background/text colors lerped to shade position, sky visibility
timing
1:1 with drag; tap-toggle animates 600ms
easing
direct drag; ease-in-out on toggle
loop
demo drags down then up
